title: Guinea bans Burkina Faso broadcaster, escalating diplomatic tensions
summary: Tensions rise between Guinea and Burkina Faso after Conakry bans Burkinabe broadcaster RTB, amid a diplomatic dispute over gold miners and a caricature of President Mamadi Doumbouya.
